subject: CSA Evidence provisioning, scope clarification and artifact bundle request
messages:
From: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@aureum.co>
To: rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security-ops@aureum.co
Date: 2025-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial CAIQ onboarding — scope & artifact ask

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for walking us through Redwood's hosted offering earlier. To finalize the CAIQ questionnaire run, we need a couple of clarifications around scope and a small sample bundle of artifacts so our compliance team can begin mapping controls. Specific asks: 

- Confirm whether the scoped tenant will include sandbox/test environments or just production. Our auditors prefer a reduced scope (prod-only) where feasible.
- A tenant boundary diagram showing network/regions and VPC boundaries.
- A sample of keystore/key rotation logs and the keystore owner contact for attestations.
- A short manifest (sheet) that maps the top ~30 prioritized CAIQ questions to artifact filenames (so we can triage).

Can you provide timelines and who on your side will own evidence requests? We have a compliance intake window next week and would like the sample bundle by EOD Tue.

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Frost | Head, Security Assurance | Aureum Financial Services

From: rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com
To: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@aureum.co>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-08-16T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial CAIQ onboarding — scope & artifact ask

Elaine — thanks for the clear list. We can do prod-only scope; sandbox artifacts can be excluded from this run. Owner details and a lightweight manifest below. Deliverables timeline:

- Tenant boundary diagram: attachment (we'll push PDF by EOD today). Owner: Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com).
- Keystore rotation logs: we will provide a 30-day sample CSV with redacted principal IDs (attached). Owner: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com).
- CAIQ manifest: short spreadsheet linking QIDs to artifacts — attached.

We will also include a short readme that maps our runtime isolation controls to the CAIQ sub-controls (e.g., tenant segregation, ephemeral keystores, KV cache segregation). If that works I'll start the upload to a shared Drive and send a Drive link.

Next steps: Kimberly will follow up with any attestation text we can include, and Marissa will send the log sample.

Thanks,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Director, Technical Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
To: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@aureum.co>, rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-08-16T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial CAIQ onboarding — scope & artifact ask

Hi Elaine — I attached the tenant boundary diagram (redwood-tenant-boundary-diagram.pdf) and a brief owner roster. A couple of clarifications from our side to speed your mapping:

- "Production" in your intake: we mean customer-facing clusters that are tenant-isolated and host live keys. We will not include ephemeral sandbox clusters.
- Keystores are rotated every 90 days; rotation events are logged to our KMS (we redact agent principals in the share). Sample attached.
- For KV cache evidence: our runtime preserves per-tenant KV namespaces; we can provide an example incident-free trace for a single tenant to show isolation. If you need live traces, we need a narrow scoped tenant and a short NDA amendment — let me know.

Attachment: redwood-tenant-boundary-diagram.pdf

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@aureum.co>, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-08-17T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial CAIQ onboarding — scope & artifact ask

Elaine — attached is the keystore sample (keystore-access-log-sample.csv) with timestamps from the last 30 days. Notes:

- Rows with MFA-based admin actions are included; we removed internal UUIDs and replaced with role tokens (AdminService, DevOps).
- Rotation events include a short rationale column (automated rotation).
- If the auditor needs HSM attestations, Kimberly can provide the vendor contact and the HSM certificate chain.

Also uploaded the CAIQ manifest (caiq-extraction-manifest.xlsx) that maps 36 prioritized questions to artifact names in the Drive folder. Link to follow.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com
To: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@aureum.co>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-08-17T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ manifest and Drive link (internal attachments)

To: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@aureum.co>
Date: 2025-08-17T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ manifest and Drive link

Elaine — I uploaded the artifacts to a shared folder and set view-only for your team. Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAureum-CAIQ

Contents:
- redwood-tenant-boundary-diagram.pdf
- keystore-access-log-sample.csv
- caiq-extraction-manifest.xlsx
- readme-control-mapping.md (short mapping rationale)

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough on Mon 8/18 to go through the manifest and identify any additional items your auditors want.

Regards,
Rohan

From: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@aureum.co>
To: rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security-ops@aureum.co
Date: 2025-08-18T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ manifest and Drive link

Team — thanks, received the bundle and reviewed the manifest. A few quick items from our compliance intake: 

- Confirmed: prod-only scope is acceptable.
- We would like a one-paragraph control owner attestation for tenant isolation and key rotation (Kimberly + Marissa). Can you provide by EOD Mon?
- On KV cache traces: the auditors will accept the static trace you suggested (no live traces required). Please include a short note in the readme indicating sampling method.
- Please create a single ZIP with the 4 artifacts and post to the Drive root so our intake automation can fetch it (naming convention: aureum_redwood_caiq_bundle_20250817.zip).

If you can get those three items done Monday morning, we will push the CAIQ mapping into our internal review queue.

Best,
Elaine
